_README.description: Model metadata for DeepSeek's first-party API (native provider, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY).
_README.usage: Exposed directly through the native DeepSeek provider (api.deepseek.com, OpenAI-compatible). These models are also reachable via OpenRouter (deepseek/... IDs); with a DeepSeek key set the native provider wins by priority so bare aliases route direct. Scores are pinned to the OpenRouter mirrors.

models.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, 2026-10-17 build (V4.1-Flash-1017) - native image understanding, 1M context, up to 384K output. deepseek-flash is DeepSeek's API model ID and always serves the latest V4.1 Flash build; the API has no pinned ID for the 2026-09-10 build, and deepseek-v4.1-flash is not an API ID (kept as an alias). Supersedes V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp, which DeepSeek retired. AA Intelligence Index 45 (max effort, read 2026-10-19). Score at the high-effort anchor is an ESTIMATE: AA lists no row at or below high (max 45); high is estimated at 40.5 (range 36-43) from the median max-to-high gap of other models.

DeepSeek V4 Pro (1M context) - prior flagship MoE reasoning model. DeepSeek keeps serving V4 Pro (V4-Pro-0813) after 2026-09-14 with billing unchanged (API change log, 2026-09-10 entry, read 2026-10-19). The bare 'deepseek' alias points at deepseek-flash. Score at the high-effort anchor is an ESTIMATE: AA lists no row at or below high (max 36); high is estimated at 31.5 (range 27-34) from the median max-to-high gap of other models.
DeepSeek V4 Flash (1M context) - fast, low-cost MoE (13B active). RETIRED by DeepSeek; API traffic now reroutes to V4.1 Flash. The bare 'deepseek-flash' alias now points at deepseek-v4.1-flash.
DeepSeek Reasoner = R1 reasoning model. Direct API; score pinned to the OpenRouter deepseek-r1 mirror.
DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision (experimental, 2026-08) - V4 Flash 0731 plus image understanding. RETIRED by DeepSeek; API traffic now reroutes to V4.1 Flash, which has native image understanding built in.
